literal_meaning: হাতে থাকা (in hand or being in one's grasp)
figurative_meaning_en: to be under control or at one's mercy
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার কর্মচারীদের হাতে রেখেছে, তাই তারা কিছু করতে পারে না।
বউটি স্বামীর হাতে থাকে, তাই সে সবকিছু মেনে চলে।
example_sentences_in_english: He keeps his employees under his control, so they can't do anything.
The wife is under her husband's thumb, so she follows everything.
note: This idiom reflects patriarchal norms in Bengali society, often used in contexts of authority and subjugation.
